title: Synthetic concurrent temperature and vibration triage
provenance_detail: Authored specifically for the ShopfloorPilot synthetic demonstration; no external manual, proprietary text, or measured factory data was used.

chunks.evidence_excerpt: In this synthetic demonstration, concurrent elevated temperature and vibration alarms are compatible with several broad conditions. Treat the combination as a triage signal, compare trends, and gather separating evidence before proposing any explanation.
observable_symptoms: concurrent elevated temperature and vibration alarms
chunks.possible_explanation: A thermal-load, rotating-element, tool-interface, lubrication, or measurement condition may be present.
suggested_checks: Compare the two signals with earlier observations from the same synthetic run.
Repeat the readings and verify sensor identity and attachment.
Record whether the readings change between unloaded and cutting conditions when an operator can check safely.
limitations: The fixture is uncalibrated and supplies no industrial alarm limits.
The signal combination supports only possible explanations, not a root-cause or repair-completion claim.
